items.criterion: The health route answers ready once the app has started.
items.judgment: A request to the health route returns a success.

items.criterion: Every seeded account, the seeded private room and its player cap exist as real rows in the declared datastore.
items.judgment: The declared datastore holds a row for each of the four seeded accounts, and a room row whose code and cap match the brief.

items.criterion: A created private room carries an eight-character code and seats the creator plus a stranger who follows the invite link.
items.judgment: Creating a room returns an eight-character code, and a join on that code leaves two players in the room snapshot.

items.criterion: The word of a live turn appears in the drawer's snapshot and in nothing any other seat receives.
items.judgment: The drawer's snapshot carries the word, and the snapshot, the room summary and the event stream a non-drawer holds carry the mask and no occurrence of the word.

items.criterion: A correct guess is announced to the room by its guesser and never by the text that was typed.
items.judgment: A guess equal to the word answers correct, and the chat a still guessing player reads holds no occurrence of the word.

items.criterion: A guess one letter from the word answers the guesser alone and does not repeat the guess back.
items.judgment: A one-letter miss answers close to its sender, and the same text appears in no other seat's snapshot.

items.criterion: The turn leaves the drawing state at the instant the last non-drawer guesses correctly.
items.judgment: After every non-drawer has guessed, the room state read from the drawer's seat is no longer drawing.

items.criterion: The drawer's standing rises once the room has worked the word out.
items.judgment: The drawer's standing after the turn ends is greater than the standing before the first guess landed.

items.criterion: A round of three turns in a room of three players produces three distinct drawers.
items.judgment: The drawer identity recorded at each of three consecutive turns is a set of three different players.

items.criterion: A correct guess sent four times moves its guesser's standing once.
items.judgment: The guesser's standing after three repeats equals the standing after the first correct guess.

items.criterion: Rejoining on a held seat token returns the same seat, the same standing and the same guessed mark.
items.judgment: A join carrying the seat token returns the original player identity, leaves the player count unchanged, and the player row still reads as having guessed.

items.criterion: A player seated mid-turn receives the ordered stroke list for the current turn inside the snapshot.
items.judgment: The snapshot the late joiner reads carries at least the strokes the drawer had already sent.

items.criterion: The word of a live room appears in no table of the declared datastore other than the word list.
items.judgment: A scan of every text column of every table other than the word list finds no row equal to the live word.

items.criterion: Two joins arriving together for one free seat produce one seated player and one redirect.
items.judgment: Exactly one of the two simultaneous joins returns a seat token, and the room's player count never exceeds its cap.

items.criterion: A caller holding neither a seat token nor a seat in a private room is denied its state.
items.judgment: The room-state call from a signed-in player with no seat, and from an anonymous caller, are both denied and carry no player list.

items.criterion: A stroke or a canvas operation from a player who is not the current drawer changes the canvas by nothing.
items.judgment: The stroke count read from the drawer's snapshot is the same before and after a non-drawer sends a stroke and a clear.

items.criterion: The report queue answers a moderator and refuses a player and an anonymous caller.
items.judgment: The queue call from a moderator returns a top-level array, and the same call from a player and from an anonymous caller is denied.

items.criterion: A mutating call carrying no session is refused and writes nothing.
items.judgment: Room creation with no session is refused, and the room row count is unchanged afterwards.

items.criterion: A settings change from a player who is not the host, and one after the game has started, are both rejected.
items.judgment: Both calls are refused and the stored settings still hold their original values.

items.criterion: Every setting outside the range the brief pins is refused.
items.judgment: Each out-of-range patch is refused and the stored settings stay inside their stated ranges.

items.criterion: A guess longer than the pinned cap and a display name outside the pinned band are both refused.
items.judgment: The over-long guess, the empty name and the over-long name are each refused.

items.criterion: An address the product does not serve renders the product's own page and answers not-found.
items.judgment: The response carries the product's own chrome rather than a bare framework string, with a not-found status.

items.criterion: Every public route answers with a strict transport policy and a nosniff content-type policy.
items.judgment: Each public route's response headers carry both policies, and the landing document carries no credential.

items.criterion: The footer of the landing route reaches a privacy page stating what the product keeps, and a terms page carrying a contact address.
items.judgment: The four footer labels appear on the landing route, the privacy page states what is kept, and the terms page carries an address.

items.criterion: Every internal link offered on a public route reaches a page the app serves.
items.judgment: Each internal href gathered from the public routes answers below a client error.

items.criterion: Body text on the landing route clears the contrast ratio the brief pins.
items.judgment: The worst text-and-background pairing measured on the landing route is at or above the pinned ratio.

items.criterion: At a phone width the landing document does not scroll sideways and both actions stay reachable.
items.judgment: The document's scroll width equals its client width, and both action labels are present.
